## Overview

:::{.column-screen-inset}
```{python}
#| echo: false
import sys
sys.path.append("..")
from core.report import build_season_grid
from core.io import load_solution, load_parquet, OUT_DIR

picks, chips = load_solution(through_gw=8)
stats = load_parquet("player_data.parquet", OUT_DIR)
names = load_parquet("names.parquet", OUT_DIR)

grid = build_season_grid(picks, stats, names, chips)
```
